scoring_justification: Recomputing from raw MD trajectories (velocity/dipole time series) is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; result-level comparison against paper-reported values with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold vibrational peak assignments from paper Table 1 (frequencies < 200 cm⁻¹)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (non-stoichiometric case, peaks below 200 cm⁻¹)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted frequency, direction, and dominant species from the paper's Table 1, filtering to frequencies below 200 cm⁻¹ per the task scope.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported vibrational assignments; the checker compares the agent's computed peaks against them.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference thermodynamic quantities (Cv, S, U, F) at 300 K from paper section 5.3
hidden_assets.generation_method: The paper reports Cv=410 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, S=300 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, U=370 kJ mol⁻¹, F=280 kJ mol⁻¹ at 300 K.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly reported paper values, which a correct reproduction should approximate within given tolerances.

outputs.description: Table of IR absorption peaks below 200 cm⁻¹ with their vibrational direction and dominant atomic species.
Thermodynamic properties at 300 K derived from the vibrational density of states.

output_contract.notes: Verification uses result-level comparison (T0) against hidden paper-reported values with tolerances for frequency and absolute tolerances for thermodynamic quantities.

steps.description: Compare agent's IR peak assignments (below 200 cm⁻¹) to paper Table 1
Compare thermodynamic quantities at 300 K to paper-reported values
